name: @mars.liu/dsh-graft
description: Graft, forward and fork DSH sessions: read a slice of one session's log, export it, fork a session at a turn boundary, or forward a selected portion into another session (or a brand-new one) as a self-contained graft message. Agent tools: graft_sessions/graft_search/graft_read/graft_export/graft_fork/graft_forward.
